name: Luminous Peptide Glaze Serum
description: An ultra-concentrated botanical elixir infusing multi-peptides, cold-pressed Nigerian baobab oil, and 3% niacinamide to illuminate melanin-rich skin while reinforcing cellular lipid barriers.

formulation.skinType: All skin types, optimized for melanin-rich & sensitive skin

accordions.bioActives: 5% Multi-Peptide Complex stimulates collagen renewal and epidermal elasticity. 3% Niacinamide smooths hyperpigmentation and refines pore architecture. Cold-pressed Baobab Oil provides concentrated Omega-3, 6, and 9 essential fatty acids.
accordions.inci: Aqua (Water), Adansonia Digitata (Baobab) Seed Oil, Niacinamide, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Butylene Glycol, Carbomer, Polysorbate 20, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin, Tocopherol (Vitamin E).
accordions.ritual: Dispense 3–4 drops onto freshly cleansed, damp skin. Gently press into face, neck, and décolletage using upward lymphatic sweeping motions. Follow with Botanical Hydration Crème. Use morning and evening.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-9218. Verified and manufactured in adherence to strict cGMP cosmetic guidelines for efficacy and safety.

name: Kalahari Melon Sun Shield SPF 50
description: A weightless fluid SPF 50 engineered specifically to leave zero white cast or ashiness on melanin-rich complexions, charged with antioxidant-dense wild Kalahari melon seed oil and mineral photoprotectors.

accordions.bioActives: Wild Kalahari Melon Seed Oil contains twice the essential fatty acid concentration of argan oil, protecting against cellular photo-damage. Ectoin shields skin from infrared radiation and atmospheric pollution.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Citrullus Lanatus (Kalahari Melon) Seed Oil, Zinc Oxide, Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate, Ectoin, Ascorbyl Tetraisopalmitate, Squalane, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, Polyhydroxystearic Acid, Caprylyl Glycol, Silica.
accordions.ritual: Apply liberally as the final step of your morning skincare ritual, 15 minutes prior to sun exposure. Reapply every 2 hours or following swimming, sweating, or towel drying.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-8842. Broad spectrum UVA/UVB protection tested to ISO 24444 standards.

name: Baobab Gentle Purifying Cleanser
description: A gentle low-foaming jelly cleanser that removes waterproof cosmetics, environmental particulates, and excess sebum without stripping the skin's delicate moisture mantle.

accordions.bioActives: Hydrolyzed Baobab protein forms a protective moisture veil during cleansing. Moringa Seed peptides gently chelate airborne heavy metals and urban micro-pollutants.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Adansonia Digitata (Baobab) Seed Extract, Moringa Oleifera Seed Extract, Chamomilla Recutita Flower Water, Panthenol, Xanthan Gum, Citric Acid, Benzyl Alcohol, Dehydroacetic Acid.
accordions.ritual: Massage 1–2 pumps onto damp skin in circular motions for 60 seconds. Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Pat dry with an organic cotton cloth.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-7193. Hypoallergenic and ophthalmologist tested for eye safety.

name: Botanical Hydration Crème
tagline: Ceramide Infused Nilotica Deep Lipid Replenishment
description: A sumptuous, cushiony moisturiser featuring certified organic Ugandan Nilotica shea butter, botanical ceramides, and fermented yeast filtrates to lock in 72-hour moisture.

accordions.bioActives: Ceramide Complex NP, AP, and EOP mirrors the natural lipid composition of the human stratum corneum. Nilotica Shea butter delivers high concentrations of oleic acid for velvety barrier cushioning.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Butyrospermum Parkii (Nilotica Shea) Butter, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Phytosphingosine, Cholesterol, Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate, Centella Asiatica Leaf Extract, Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Carbomer, Phenoxyethanol.
accordions.ritual: Warm a hazelnut-sized portion between fingertips and press into face, neck, and collarbones following serum application. Ideal for both AM and PM rituals.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-9405. Formulated without pore-clogging waxes or synthetic dyes.

name: Marula Barrier Repair Oil
tagline: Virgin Cold-Pressed Liquid Gold Botanical Concentrate
description: 100% pure unrefined cold-pressed Southern African Marula oil, rich in polyphenols, flavonoids, and natural squalene to repair damaged lipid barriers and restore incandescent luminosity.

keyActives: 100% Pure Virgin Sclerocarya Birrea (Marula) Kernel Oil

accordions.bioActives: High levels of oleic acid (70-78%) and potent antioxidants combat cellular oxidation, calm skin reactivity, and lock in trans-epidermal moisture.
accordions.inci: 100% Sclerocarya Birrea (Marula) Seed Oil (Virgin, Unrefined, Cold-Pressed). Zero additives, preservatives, or artificial fragrances.
accordions.ritual: Press 2–3 drops onto clean skin as the final sealing step in your evening ritual, or mix 1 drop into your foundation or moisturiser for a bespoke dewy finish.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-8119. Certified 100% pure organic botanical origin.

name: Hibiscus AHA Glow Tonic
tagline: Gentle Micro-Exfoliating Flower Acid Resurfacing Elixir
description: A botanical exfoliating toner marrying hibiscus flower acids with lactic acid and aloe vera leaf juice to gently dissolve dead cellular debris without causing post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation.

formulation.skinType: Melanin-rich skin prone to texture, uneven tone, and congestion

accordions.bioActives: Hibiscus Sabdariffa organic flower acids stimulate rapid cell turnover while natural anthocyanocides soothe cutaneous irritation. Licorice Root Extract inhibits melanin synthesis enzymes.
accordions.inci: Aqua, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Lactic Acid, Hibiscus Sabdariffa Flower Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Sodium Hydroxide, Glycerin, Propanediol, Allantoin, Phenoxyethanol, Ethylhexylglycerin.
accordions.ritual: Saturate a reusable cotton pad and sweep across cleansed face and neck, avoiding the eye contour. Use 2–3 evenings per week. Always follow with Kalahari Melon SPF 50 during the day.
accordions.nafdac: NAFDAC Reg. No. 04-7801. Formulated to safely resurface without photosensitizing melanin-rich skin.
